blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to National Government & Digital Services. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

National digital government builds shared rails — identity, data exchange, notification, payments — and industrializes citizen services on top. Success is measured in take-up, resolution and trust; failure modes are silos, legacy cores and unaccountable AI.

items: Nation-state targeting meets legacy estates; accreditation drag.
Citizens re-submit facts; fraud/error hide at seams.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Security & Model Protection, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, AI Security & Model Protection from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Citizen service delivery, Benefits/licensing casework, Interagency data exchange) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR/national privacy among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure the models themselves: prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery: resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere: compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Identity-centric access across agencies (threat surface reduced)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: identity-centric access across agencies and third parties (state-grade threat surface reduced with evidence). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
